detail.longDescription: OpenClaw Enterprise was announced on 29 September by the OpenClaw Foundation. The project calls it "Kubernetes for agents": one control plane for many agents, walls between teams and a record of every action. Built with Red Hat and NVIDIA, in pilots today, full release later in 2026. For one person or a small team with one agent, the standard setup stays the same. https:// oneclickclaw.io/news/openclaw- enterprise-one-person-small-team?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=openclaw-enterprise-one-person-small-team&utm_content=day0 # OpenClaw # AIagents # SelfHosted # LLM Drafted with AI help, reviewed by the OneClickClaw team.
